conditions.boolean: Exact pinned Boolean.valueOf chooses cached constants only; dependence follows each actual primitive operand, never cached identity.
conditions.decimal: Exact pinned BigDecimal(int) constructs an exact scale-zero integer in a fresh object; no arbitrary Number/subclass or arithmetic support.
conditions.assert: Only Object,String overload; checks reference null and creates actual IllegalArgumentException on non-null; Supplier/other overloads are not modeled.
conditions.enum: Planner proves closed javac8 enum constructor/clinit and constant table. Runtime checks actual class, name, ordinal and constant identity; no arbitrary initializer or enum subclass.
conditions.defaults: Only local NEW with paired supported constructor, witnessed immediately after empty Object constructor, version-zero defaults and closed constructor evidence. Opaque effects or later versions invalidate them.
